nadine: Heads-up: we're changing how hosted usage is metered on invoices. Starting with billing periods beginning 2026-06-01 we'll switch to a 60-second aggregation window for token metering. This is to reduce variability from short spikes and make per-minute charges more predictable.

nadine: Important: this is a metering change only. No change to per-second/per-minute rate limits or throttling behavior. It's strictly about how usage is aggregated for billable units.

jon: Can you explain why? Will customers see refunds or adjustments? :thinking:

nadine: Short answer: customers with very bursty traffic saw large invoice swings due to microsecond sampling. By aggregating into 60s buckets we smooth that. For any invoices already issued we will NOT retroactively rebill; for unsettled invoices finance will run a reconciliation and issue adjustments if the delta > $50.

ryan: Will this affect customers using real-time streaming pricing?

nadine: Streaming pricing remains per-token, but the invoice line items will show per-minute aggregates and a "smoothing adjustment" line when applicable. There is an internal explainer in the billing doc: https://redwood.internal/billing/metering-60s (read-only).

billing-bot: Example invoice snippet:
```
2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30 - Hosted API tokens (60s aggregated): 4,512,000 tokens
Burst noise smoothing credit: -$12.45 (applied when aggregation reduces billed tokens)
Final token charge: $XXX.XX
```

support-lead: Heads-up for support macros: please use this copy: "We updated our meter aggregation to 60s windows to stabilize invoices for bursty workloads. This does not change rate limits or model routing. If you believe your invoice needs manual review, reply with your account ID and invoice number."

jon: Any impact on billing dashboards / per-route breakouts?

nadine: Dashboards will show both raw event counts and the aggregated 60s-bucketed billing view. Platform metrics team will add a toggle to compare pre/post-aggregation. Expect a small delta in the cost-per-route breakdown.

ops-eng: We'll watch the metering pipeline over next two deploys for regressions. If you see "metering-processor lag" alerts, tag me.

ryan: How should sales talk about this with prospective customers asking about quotas?

nadine: Script for AE: "We recently standardized billing aggregation to 60s windows to make invoices more predictable for bursty workloads; quotas and SLA-backed Dedicated capacity are unchanged."

support-lead: I'll add the macro to Zendesk and ping CS. Ops: expect a handful of tickets the first week, esp. from low-volume customers who rounded up previously.

jon: Thanks. Anything else ops/infra should watch for?

ops-eng: Watch for increased cardinality in billing logs due to bucketed keys. We have a plan to sample at 0.1% if cardinality > X. I'll post details in the doc.

nadine: Thanks everyone. If you find edge cases (reseller invoicing, consolidated billing accounts) add them to the tracker in the doc and ping me.
